runtime: Installed Windows reviewer environment with source-path overlay

harbor.design: Five predeclared pairs; fresh conversation per turn, all retained

visual.design: Adaptive walkthrough: complex question fails before generation; direct-reading auto/text gives wrong value; manually request page-image; image-removed generation control

redactions: Credential-free records only; machine-local absolute path prefixes replaced. No answer/evidence words, routes, or outcomes changed.
image_serialization: Data URLs externalized losslessly as PNG plus SHA-256 and original encoding prefix. Reconstruct by encoding those exact bytes.

public_recipe_validation.interpretation: Fresh execution of the supplied chart script on the same page/question; not a second independent task.
